child_list.content: The goose with the golden eggs

elements.content: There once was a man who had a very fine goose. Every day the goose laid a golden egg. The man soon became rich. But as he became rich, he became greedy. “The goose must be gold inside,” he thought to himself. “I will open her, and get all the gold at once.” So he killed the goose, but he found no gold. The man cried and said, “I should have been happy with the golden egg each day.”

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 下金蛋的鹅
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 从前，有一个人，他有一只非常好的鹅。鹅每天下一个金蛋。这个人很快就富了起来。但随着他变得富有，他变得贪婪起来。“这只鹅里面一定有金子，” 他想。“我要把她打开，立刻把金子都拿出来。”所以他杀了鹅，但他没有找到金子。这个人哭着说：“我应该满足于每天得到的金蛋才对。”
child_list.name: 文本框

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
